events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Morgan Rielly scored his first two goals of the season, including the 100th of his career, to lead the Toronto Maple Leafs to a 3-1 victory over the Boston Bruins on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morgan Rielly scores twice as Maple Leafs defeat Bruins, who lose David Pastrnak to injury

events.name: Calgary Flames at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Connor Brown scored the go-ahead goal off a scramble in front with 3:58 remaining to lead the New Jersey Devils to a come-from-behind 5-3 win over the Calgary Flames on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Brown's third-period goal lifts Devils to a 5-3 comeback win over Flames

headlines.description: — Vincent Trocheck scored the only goal of the shootout and the Utah Mammoth beat the Nashville Predators 6-5 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trocheck's shootout goal lifts Mammoth to a 6-5 win over the Predators

events.name: Dallas Stars at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Aleksanteri Kaskimaki's goal in the third period put the St. Louis Blues ahead for good in a 5-3 victory over the Dallas Stars on Friday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaskimaki's go-ahead goal helps Blues to 5-3 win over Stars

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Linus Ullmark stopped 18 shots, Michael Amadio had a goal and two assists and Tim Stutzle scored twice as the Ottawa Senators defeated the Tampa Bay Lightning 6-2 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators top Lightning 6-2 in historic win for Linus Ullmark

headlines.description: — Travis Konecny, Porter Martone and Tyson Foerster scored on the power play and the Flyers beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-2 Friday with Philadelphia leading scorer Matvei Michkov benched.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flyers beat Canucks 5-2 after leading scorer Matvei Michkov is benched for 'internal team matter'

headlines.description: — Sam Bennett scored with 24 seconds remaining, the 200th goal of his career, and the Florida Panthers rallied past the Washington Capitals 3-2 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Bennett scores 200th career goal with 24 seconds left as Panthers beat Capitals 3-2

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — J.T. Compher and Alex DeBrincat scored, and John Gibson made 18 saves for his 29th career shutout as the Detroit Red Wings beat Columbus 2-0 Friday, sending the Blue Jackets to their fifth consecutive home loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gibson records 29th career shutout as Red Wings beat the Blue Jackets 2-0

headlines.description: — Cale Makar was the lone scorer in the shootout, and the Colorado Avalanche rallied from a three-goal deficit in the third period for a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Makar gets shootout winner as Avalanche overcome 3-goal, 3rd-period deficit to beat Wild 4-3

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Mats Zuccarello scored two goals, Andre Lee got the tiebreaking goal early in the third period and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Anaheim Ducks 5-3 Friday in the first Freeway Faceoff rivalry game of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mats Zuccarello, Andre Lee lead LA Kings past Ducks 5-3 in first Freeway Faceoff of season

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Yaroslav Askarov made 27 saves and the San Jose Sharks beat Vegas 4-1 on Friday for the franchise’s first regulation victory over the Golden Knights at SAP Center.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharks beat Vegas 4-1 for franchise’s first regulation win over Golden Knights at SAP Center

events.name: New York Rangers at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Andrew Mangiapane scored two power-play goals in the first period, Spencer Knight made 30 saves and the Chicago Blackhawks held off the New York Rangers 2-1 on Friday night for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mangiapane scores twice, Knight makes 30 saves to help Blackhawks edge Rangers 2-1

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Kyle Connor had two goals and an assist and the Winnipeg Jets extended their winning streak to three games with a 3-1 victory over the New York Islanders on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor scores twice and the Jets beat the Islanders 3-1 for 3rd straight win

headlines.description: — Ben Kindel, Rutger McGroarty, Ville Koivunen and Evgeni Malkin each had a goal and an assist, and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Buffalo Sabres 6-3 on Friday night to snap a five-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Penguins snap a 5-game skid with a 6-3 victory over the Sabres

headlines.description: — Kaapo Kakko scored twice in a two-minute span in the third period and the Seattle Kraken beat Edmonton 4-2 on Friday night, handing the Oilers their fifth straight loss in the opener the home-and-home set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kakko scores twice in 3rd as Kraken hand Oilers their 5th straight loss
